prerequisites: Particle properties and individual separation principles and separation velocities.
Basic types of particle separators and its properties and field of use.
Total and grade efficiency of separation.
Separation principles and overall grade efficiency of separation of single fibre and of the filter layer.
Pressure drop of the filter layer and of the whole filter unit.
Classification and use of filters for general ventilation.
HEPA and ULPA filters and clean rooms.
Industrial filtration - performance, choice of filter material and dimensioning the filter area.

learning_outcomes.text: To get fundamental knowledge and skills in area of solid particles separation.
To acquire context between surface, mobility, electrical and transfer particle properties and individual particle separation principles and particle separators.
To get fundamental knowledge and skills in area of solid particle filtration in ventilation and air conditioning and in the industry.
Knowledge of designing and dimensioning of filters for individual purposes.

syllabus_topics: Particle size and particle size distribution.
Gravitational, inertial, centrifugal and electrical principle of separation.
Total and grade efficiency of separation.
Classification of particle separators, characteristic features.
Industrial fabric filters and atmospheric air filters - differences and common feature.
Particle efficiency of separation of single fibre and fibrous layer.
Pressure drop of fibrous layer (filter medium) and filter.
Classification and use of filters for general ventilation.
HEPA and ULPA filters - classification and use.
Industrial fabric filters, filter media, characteristic features, use.
Settling velocity for small and high Re.
Velocity of separation in centrifugal principle.
Charge of particles and velocity of separation in electrical precipitators.
Calculation of individual particle separation principles of single fibre.
Overall grade efficiency of the single fibre and of the filter layer.
Pressure drop of the clean filter layer and pressure drop increase with dust loading.
bibliography: Noel de Nevers: Air pollution control engineering, McGraw-Hill,Inc., 1995.
Brown R. C.: Air filtration, Pergamon Press, 1993
Flagan, R.C., Seinfeld, J.H.: Fundamentals of Air Pollution Engineering, Prentice Hall, 1988, ISBN 0-13-332537-7
Hinds, W.C.: Aerosol Technology: Properties, Behaviour and Measurement of Airborne Particles, Wiley, 1999, ISBN 0-471-19410-7
